book_intro:
Blue Letter Bible bakanlığı ve BLB Enstitüsü, Kutsal Yazıların tahrif edilemezliğine olan kesin inancı içeren tarihsel, muhafazakar Hristiyan inancına bağlıdır. notes.text: David organizes the priests into 24 divisions by lot. Each division was to serve for two weeks of the year, based on a lunar calendar of 48 weeks.
Nadab and Abihu died. See Lev. 10:1–3. The priesthood was hereditary. It descended through the lines of Eleazar and Ithamar.
Zadok. See 1 Kings 1:8; 2:35. Ahimelech. The son of Abiathar (2 Sam. 8:17), with whom Zadok is usually paired (2 Sam. 15:35; 1 Kings 4:4).
Specific duties were assigned by drawing lots between the families of Eleazar and of Ithamar.
Hakkoz. See Ezra 2:61–63. Abijah. An ancestor of John the Baptist (Luke 1:5).
The list of Levites in 23:6–23 is updated to include another generation in six of the Levitical families.
